full_name: ESA International Conference on Guidance, Navigation & Control Systems (GNC), joint with the International Conference on Astrodynamics Tools and Techniques (ICATT) since 2021
organizer: European Space Agency (ESA), with the ESA Conference Bureau / ATPI Corporate Events
frequency: Irregular, about every 2-3 years (GNC: 2014, 2017, 2021, 2023, 2026; ICATT standalone in 2016 and 2018)

submission.type: Abstract submission, then a mandatory full paper (PDF, STIX Two Text font, ESA template); each paper gets a DOI in a public repository
submission.typical_abstract_deadline: About 7 months before the event (2026: 27 Feb 2026)
submission.typical_final_deadline: About 1 month before the event (2026: 31 Jul, extended to 31 Aug 2026)
submission.notes: 2026 calendar: call for abstracts 9 Jan 2026; abstract deadline 27 Feb 2026; notification 17 Apr 2026; full paper 31 Aug 2026 (extended) (https://atpi.eventsair.com/gncicatt/calendar-of-events).

editions.venue: Crowne Plaza Salzburg - The Pitter (10th GNC)

editions.notes: Cross-checked 2026-10-16: abstract_deadline filled 2023-01-20 from official calendar of events (no extension shown). Indico page: https://indico.esa.int/event/449/.

notes: The most recent edition, Sevilla, 28 Sep - 2 Oct 2026, ended two weeks before the research date, and no next edition is announced. The 2014 Porto dates come from a TU Dresden publication citation ('Oporto, Portugal, 2-6 June 2014') as surfaced in search, not an ESA page. 2021 dates: GMV says 21-25 June; another listing says 22-25 June. The 2023 venue in Sopot is not named on Indico. Do not confuse this series with CEAS EuroGNC, a separate biennial conference. Abstract deadlines before 2026 were not found. The 2016 and 2018 entries are standalone ICATT editions, included because ICATT is now merged with GNC.

verification.crosscheck: independent blind re-research of 2022+ editions, conflicts adjudicated 2026-10-16
